'''CoMar Combat Systems''', also called '''CoMar Weapons''',<ref name="EGWT" /> was a weapons manufacturing corporation, based in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. They specialized in large-scale [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] and low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] [[blaster artillery]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The company manufactured the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]]<ref name="EGWT" /> as well as the [[G-003 Tri-Tracker]], which was used by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
